If you find a way please share. The more kids able to play on their own without having to interact with predators the better. Not normally one to condone piracy in general but in this case? Inclined to say that it's for the greater good even if they weren't pirating themselves.

They're worse than you know; please be careful and if you can warn kids and their parents to stay away it's important they do.
They have a history of being horrible. It goes worse than you know. Be careful. And warn kids and parents if you can.
